payload.body:
Lane A (lane name: driver-lanes2): the ROOT-WAKE CHANNEL LAYER for issue #564. Read the shared-context entry root-wake/contract first; it is the frozen interface and the evidence table.

TARGET
- New file: impl/src/root-wake.mjs (the module the contract freezes).
- New test file: impl/test/root-wake-channels-red.test.mjs.
- Do not edit wake-stream.mjs, swarm-runtime.mjs or application-deployment.mjs: lane B owns those. If you need a change there, say so in needsFromOthers instead.

CHANGE
1. Build ROOT_WAKE_HARNESSES + the six-channel table with the evidence from root-wake/contract. Each row carries: harness, channel (a stable token: 'cli_resume' | 'cli_exec_resume' | 'cli_print_resume' | 'acp_session_prompt'), wakeable (true), mechanism (one sentence naming the exact command/flags), evidence (the help text or adapter file path), note (the caveats: e.g. claude-code's "already running -> starts a copy and says so"; codex's app-server daemon as the longer-term channel; the cc-socks frame shape being unverified).
2. rootWakeTurnStart(harness, {sessionRef, frameText}) builds the argv per harness from the evidence table. A missing sessionRef or frameText returns null; an unknown harness returns null.
3. normalizeRootWakeTarget(value): a closed-shape validator for the declaration the deployment will carry ({harness, sessionRef}): unknown harnesses are refused (return null or throw the deployment's own typed error - your choice, but state it in the row), missing sessionRef is refused. This is the 'where a harness cannot be woken, say so up front' input on the channel side.
4. deliverRootWake({target, frame}, seams): 
   - no target -> {ok:false, reason:'no_target'}; unknown harness -> 'unknown_harness'; a harness row that is not wakeable -> 'no_turn_starting_channel'; a spawn seam that throws -> 'spawn_failed' (never propagate); a session that is already running (the seam reports it, or the harness's own refusal text matches) -> 'session_running'; success -> {ok:true, reason:'delivered', receipt:{sentAt, sent}}.
   - The transport: an injected spawn seam by default runs the turn-starting argv from rootWakeTurnStart; the frame text is the turn prompt. Test with fakes only.
5. RED-FIRST rows (each must fail before your file exists / before the change, then pass):
   A1 every harness in ROOT_WAKE_HARNESSES has a row with non-empty mechanism + evidence; A2 the table order matches ROOT_WAKE_HARNESSES; A3 rootWakeTurnStart produces the exact argv for each of the six harnesses; A4 a missing sessionRef/frameText is null, not a broken argv; A5 deliverRootWake with no_target; A6 with unknown_harness; A7 with a non-wakeable row (construct one) -> no_turn_starting_channel; A8 a throwing spawn seam -> spawn_failed, and the receipt is null; A9 a successful fake spawn -> delivered with a receipt carrying sentAt + a sent id; A10 normalizeRootWakeTarget refuses an unknown harness and accepts each supported one; A11 the claude-code note names the unverified socket and the row does NOT default to it.

ACCEPTANCE
- node --test test/root-wake-channels-red.test.mjs from impl/ is green, and the file was red before the module existed (record both observed counts).
- Publish one contribution with the closed shape: items, files, the exact test command, the observed counts, carriedForward (what lane B still needs) and needsFromOthers (any edit you need in lane B's files).

CONTEXT: your lane branch baton/ws-f4507e249932dfcb026b7ccaa7e05eb0 is at bfaa6e75 with the driver work already published and accepted; commit this lane's work on top of it or on a fresh branch based on origin/master 65c913f0 - state which. Do not integrate, do not push.
